reviewer.method: Independent repository/source review in isolated worktree; source and query-answer review recorded per row. No model self-grading and no human adjudication.

summary.releaseCalibration: NOT EVALUATED; this artifact is development-only and is not a reviewed gold dataset or certification.

datasetFindings.finding: The supposed held_out split is not a blind evaluation set: queries routinely contain the exact source-document/design title and reuse a narrow set of query templates. This causes title/source leakage and makes retrieval success non-representative. Do not use for release calibration or claim SPEC §27 coverage.

Coverage is materially incomplete: no reviewed 500-query human gold cohort and several required SPEC §27 classes are absent (including no-answer, stale/conflict, deleted/revoked, OCR, long-document, UUID/error-code/multi-hop/follow-up/typo and Thai-only coverage). Class counts are query labels, not evidence of metric evaluation.

All 549 source groups are unique and stay within one split; exact normalized query duplicates were not found. This does not eliminate semantic/template near-duplicates or leakage between related planning/spec documents.

50 candidates have English query labels but Thai expected-answer text. This is supported by source in most inspected cases, but the answer language and scoring policy need adjudication before use in an English-answer benchmark.

Repository files are MIT-licensed and candidate metadata consistently records owner-authorized non-production repository use; no tenant production data is present. This is an artifact provenance check, not independent legal advice or a certification of all embedded third-party materials.
